title: Release State v1
description: The whole content of specs/releases/<release-id>/_RELEASE.json: one mutable state document whose transitions are written by release.py. Per candidate, `release.py phase` advances DEFINITION to IMPLEMENTATION to CLOSURE once and stamps `defined` then `implemented`; `release.py new` alone reopens the next candidate at DEFINITION. `release.py ship` writes `shipped` once after promotion. `log` is append-only governance narrative, oldest first, with each entry classified by the closed `kind` enum. Historical documents remain readable.

schema.description: This schema's own id, carried in every document for a self-describing file.

release.description: Bare SemVer release id (e.g. '0.6.0') — matches the directory name this file lives under.

phase.description: The release's current lifecycle phase. The three canonical phases enumerated here equal the dd-release-implementation _release_schema.py PHASES. Overwritten in place on every phase transition — no history of prior phases survives in this field; a transition worth remembering is recorded as a `log` entry.

defined.description: Set once, at the definition promotion commit (dd-product-engineer). null before that point.

sha.description: The commit sha supplied when release.py phase enters CLOSURE; a historical implementation milestone, not a final-HEAD or reviewer verdict.

implemented.description: Stamped once per candidate by release.py phase on entry to CLOSURE. null before that point.

shipped.description: Set once, at the integration->principal ship merge. null before that point.

log.description: Append-only governance narrative living inside this mutable document, oldest first. Legacy kinds remain schema-readable; release.py check restricts entries after the live candidate's birth to note, milestone, summary and closure-only memory.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp this note was appended.

agent.description: Agent or runtime that appended this note.

kind.description: The entry category. The enum retains historical kinds; current candidates write only note, milestone, summary and closure-only memory.

candidate.description: kind 'milestone' only: the candidate folder the stamp belongs to.

milestone.description: kind 'milestone' only: which slot the stamp set; the slot keeps the live candidate's value, these entries keep every candidate's.

sha.description: kind 'milestone' only: the commit the stamp names.

since.description: kind 'memory' only: the commit the reconciliation window opened at — the previous memory entry's until, else defined.sha.

until.description: kind 'memory' only: the HEAD the reconciliation window closed at; the next window opens here.

reviewed.description: kind 'memory' only: the worklist entries read against their sources' diff and left as they were.

changed.description: kind 'memory' only: the worklist entries rewritten by this reconciliation.
